title: Graph editor and handle types
summary: The graph editor shows each animated value over time: isolate X, key X = 0 on frame 1 and X = 25 on frame 40. The default interpolation eases in and out (the S curve: slow start, fast middle, slow stop), the most natural motion. Handle types (V): Vector makes a key sharp and linear, Auto Clamped smooth without overshoot.

objects.name: Cube
objects.description: slides 25 m along X in 40 frames with an S curve, then a linear return

expected_result: The cube eases from X 0 to 25 over frames 1-40, then comes back linearly by frame 70.

steps.note: start clean: Alt+I, the old keys go
only the X location: 0 on frame 1
25 on frame 40: the S curve (ease in and out)
V > Vector: the handle points at the previous key: a sharp, linear move back
a camera far enough to see the 25 m slide
